limitations: Finite homogeneous unit-cube analytical discretizations and four nonhomogeneous affine-pressure controls.

Original residuals are Euclidean weak-equation row norms; physical L2 errors are separate.
Coherent basis rotations are saved coordinate changes without new PDE solves.
artifact_policy: Numerical results and project attribution are published separately; private reference execution sources are excluded from release artifacts.
